headline: Gentoo Media Reports Third-Quarter EBITDA of €8.5 Million
summary: IGaming company Gentoo Media reported a third-quarter EBITDA of €8.5 million, compared with €9.3 million in the same period last year, and lowered its financial outlook.
why: Quarterly earnings reports for digital gaming affiliates reflect online traffic monetization and regulatory compliance costs.

impacts.name: Gentoo Media
impacts.why: Lower EBITDA figures and guidance revisions directly impact equity valuations.
